user.title: Hisense VIDAA TV
user.description: Enter the TV's IP address. Providing the MAC address enables Wake-on-LAN power-on and is recommended on recent firmware.

pair.title: Pair with the TV
pair.description: A 4-digit PIN is shown on the TV screen. Enter it below. If it expires, leave it and submit again to get a new one.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-pair with the TV
reauth_confirm.description: The saved token is no longer valid. A 4-digit PIN is shown on the TV screen; enter it to re-pair.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to the TV. Make sure it is on and reachable on the network.
error.invalid_auth: PIN not accepted or expired. Check the code on the TV and try again.

send_key.name: Send key
send_key.description: Send a raw remote-control key press to the TV.

key.name: Key
key.description: Friendly key name or raw VIDAA code (e.g. KEY_POWER).

launch_app.name: Launch app
launch_app.description: Launch an app on the TV by name.

app.name: App
app.description: App name (e.g. netflix, youtube) or an installed app's exact name.
